description: An ordinary graphics processor has no reason to carry the console storage modes, and expanding them at load time is wasted work. Textures are cooked directly uploadable. The ceiling is a policy budget, not hardware. level_textures (brush materials baked by the level compiler) is intentionally absent: desktop memory has no reason to cap what a level can pin. Shaders ship as loose files beside the archive, for the two dialects this platform's renderers load: WGSL for the Metal backend and core GLSL for the OpenGL fallback. The legacy GLSL path exists only on Win32.
